GENERATED MEMO:
# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

## 1. Executive Summary

**Date of Agreement:** September 22, 2021

**Borrower/Company Overview:** LSB Industries, Inc., a Delaware corporation, along with certain subsidiaries serving as borrowers (including Chemex I Corp., Cherokee Nitrogen LLC, EDC AG Products Company L.L.C., El Dorado Ammonia L.L.C., El Dorado Chemical Company, El Dorado Nitrogen L.L.C., LSB Chemical L.L.C., Pryor Chemical Company, and Trison Construction, Inc.).

**Transaction Description:** This transaction represents a consent and fourth amendment to an existing Third Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement originally dated January 17, 2017. Wells Fargo Capital Finance, LLC serves as the administrative agent and arranger, with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association participating as a lender.

**Purpose of Financing:** The amendment provides lender consent for: (i) an equity exchange transaction where LSB Funding LLC will exchange shares of the Parent's Series E-1 and Series F-1 Redeemable Preferred Stock for common stock, and (ii) dividend payments to holders of Series B 12% Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock and Series D 6% Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock up to $2,000,000 in aggregate.

**Company Background:** Based on the subsidiary names and operations referenced, LSB Industries appears to be a chemical manufacturing company with operations in nitrogen-based chemicals, ammonia production, and related industrial chemicals, with facilities in locations including El Dorado and Pryor.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• Established lending relationship with original credit facility dating to 2017
• Wells Fargo as administrative agent and lender provides institutional credibility
• Secured facility with liens and security interests maintained across loan parties
• Borrower representations confirm no existing defaults or events of default
• Amendment includes specific carve-outs for "Permitted Holders" (Eldridge Industries LLC and related entities), suggesting sophisticated sponsor involvement
• LSB Notes structure allows for up to $500MM in 2023 senior secured notes, expandable to $600MM upon refinancing

**Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:**
• Change of Control provisions indicate heightened lender sensitivity to ownership changes
• Equity exchange transaction triggering amendment requirement suggests complex capital structure
• Multiple subsidiary borrowers and guarantors create operational complexity
• Amendment required for relatively modest $2MM dividend payment suggests restrictive covenant structure
• Limited financial details available in amendment document to assess underlying credit quality
